finalMessage: I couldn't run any of the verification commands, so nothing is verified yet. Each `python3` and `./gradlew` call was blocked pending approval, which I didn't get. All four files are written. Nothing has been compiled, executed or JSON-validated. **Files changed** - `app/src/test/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/report/PatientPrintHtmlGeneratorTest.kt` - `app/src/test/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/state/IntakeDatingRuleTest.kt` (new) - `.agents/checks/check_r3.py` (new) - `.agents/TEST_MANIFEST.json` **What I did per oracle** - **Q19(a)–(g):** new `q19*` tests in the print test, each checking exact strings with both presence and absence. - Missing is covered as null, empty and whitespace-only. - (a) Three "Not recorded" cells, no "Cephalic", "Posterior Grade I" or "Adequate (AFI 14cm)"; "Breech" prints unchanged. - (b) "NKDA" absent when allergy is missing and printed only if typed; a present allergy prints exactly as typed with the `text-rose font-bold` styling. - (c) No ">None<" anywhere. - (d) Target Delivery Timing (also with no dating at all). - (e) The exact `Risk not recorded` with neither the High nor the Normal badge. - (f) The expected value comes from `parseDeliveryNotes(notes).plan`. - (g) The owner wording still prints. - **Q17 assertion changed:** in `q17_riskLevelsNonHigh_normalRiskBadge` I removed `null` from the list, because Q19(e) supersedes it. Nothing else was weakened. - **Q20:** all 9 spec examples exactly, plus 5 boundary tests: - leap year (`2028-02-29` → `2028-12-05`) - whitespace-only `ultrasoundEdd` treated as missing - lowercase method `"lmp"` - impossible date `2026-02-30` → null - padded existing LMP equal to the draft → null - **S1–S4:** `check_r3.py` prints PASS/FAIL per sub-check and exits 1 on any FAIL. - S2 is a textual check that every non-metadata insert sits inside an `if (includeDemoPatients)` block. - It should fail on S1–S4 against today's code, because `plusDays(280)` is present and the other three changes don't exist yet. That is untested. - **Manifest:** added `UNIT-intake-dating` and `STATIC-r3` with the specified deps. `UNIT-print` now also lists `DeliveryNotesParser.kt` and covers Q19. Existing entries and ids are untouched. **Assumptions** - `IntakeDatingRuleTest` won't compile until `IntakeDating` and `intakeDatingUpdate` exist. That is expected. - In the print test, `parseDeliveryNotes` is imported from `ui`. I assumed `internal` visibility is reachable from the same module's tests. - The fixture note for the Q19(f) plan test is "Elective repeat caesarean booked at 39 weeks". The test asserts the parser returns a non-null plan for it, so it fails loudly if my assumption about the parser is wrong. **Not run** - The print test class (the expected failures could not be listed). - `IntakeDatingRuleTest`. - `check_r3.py`. - JSON validation of the manifest. If you approve `python3 .agents/checks/check_r3.py` and `./gradlew --offline :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*PatientPrintHtmlGeneratorTest'`, I'll run them and report.
